from common import *
import ast
P=ROOT/'backtest/experiments/models/training-target/quantile-n-p50-20261107-v1/docs'
s=read(P/'adapter-train.json')['source_text']
pairs=[
("choices=['new','old']","choices=['new']"),
("'label_horizon':20","'label_horizon':HORIZONS[a.variant]"),
("expected=read(PRIOR/'docs/inputs-h20.json');xsha=","expected=prepared['expectations'][a.variant];xsha="),
("expected['training']['index_sha256']","expected['index_sha256']"),
("assert vsig==expected['valid_signature'] and msig==expected['tradable_signature']","valid_expected=read(PRIOR/'docs/inputs-h20.json');assert vsig==valid_expected['valid_signature'] and msig==valid_expected['tradable_signature']"),
("session=f'quantilen_20261107_{a.variant}_{a.treatment}_s{a.seed}'","session=f'pathsumq10_20261107_{a.variant}_s{a.seed}'"),
("'label_expr':'Ref($close,-21)/Ref($close,-1)-1'","'label_expr':read(BASE/'configs/frozen-study.json')['confirmed_formula'] if a.variant.startswith('sum') else f'Ref($close,-{HORIZONS[a.variant]+1})/Ref($close,-1)-1'"),
("'label_quantization':a.variant","'label_quantization':None if a.variant=='sum20continuous' else 10,'label_recipe':a.variant"),
("'frozen_hyperparams':'B3-M single,patience50,graded H20'","'frozen_hyperparams':'B3-M single,patience50; target-only study'"),
]
for a,b in pairs:
 assert a in s,a;s=s.replace(a,b)
ast.parse(s);(TMP/'train.py').write_text(s)
s=read(P/'adapter-infer.json')['source_text'];ast.parse(s);(TMP/'infer.py').write_text(s)
s=read(P/'adapter-train_group_single.json')['source_text']
s=s.replace("amendment=read(BASE/'configs/single-source-amendment.json');check(read(PROGRESS)['source_amendment'])\n    treatments=[amendment['job_treatments'][variant]]","treatments=['new']")
ast.parse(s);(TMP/'train_group.py').write_text(s)
save_source(__file__)
print('Adapted training/input verification, annual formal inference, and five-seed group execution.')
